main.result_summary:
Consolidation 003 is committed as `360526a` and not pushed, because the run header says the runner pushes after its own checks. That overrides the "git push" line at the end of the instructions. Lint and `sleep-audit.py` were both green on the first try, so no repair or reset was needed.

- **What went in:** all 48 messages with notes from 13–19 Dec 1999 are now in L1, each fact linked to its source message. That made 18 new topic files and 3 updated ones, plus 5 new people files (Vince Kaminski as the owner, Clayton Vernon, Vasant Shanbhogue, Joseph Hrgovcic, Kevin Moore).
- **Main topics:** the owner chairing at POWER 2000 (9 May 2000), European Energy 2000 and the New York Real Options conference; emission-trading material for Poland; Vernon's gas price model, still waiting for the owner's go-ahead; the PSE swap request for a volatility and CPI correlation estimate; the CreditManager meeting moved to 7 Jan 2000; a recruiting file; the ENA reorganisation; the new officer review process; the Credit Markets Group; and new equipment for the 19th floor.
- **Drops and gates:** every message with notes is cited, so `dataset/drops/sleep-003.tsv` is empty. No questions, no sleep tasks and no approval-gated changes came up.
- **Other updates:** the indexes and `state.md` (as of 1999-12-19) are refreshed. No file was above 90% of its ceiling, so the compression quota had nothing to act on. The one ongoing line I checked (vega validation) is still open. The processed logs moved to `memory/archive/inbox/`.

The runner's `dataset/runs/sleep-003.transcript.jsonl` is still uncommitted, as in earlier runs.
